symbols.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
doc: A request that is not answered in this time ends with a message: I never want a form to stay greyed (busy) for ever.

symbols.name: CHANGE_NEEDS_NEW_NUMBER
doc: Set to true and the change form saves only when the PAX NUMBER has been changed (my rule of 31 Oct 2026); set to false and it saves when the department, the location or the number has been changed (23 Nov 2026)

symbols.name: PaxAdminPanel
symbols.sig: export function PaxAdminPanel({ open, initialDepartments }: { open: PaxAdminOpen; initialDepartments?: string[] })

behaviours: three labelled inputs: Department, Location, PAX number
the number input allows five characters and a numeric keypad, and says the rule in words
the location hint says what an empty location shows (Office)
what was typed is in the fields
NO <form> tag (the search modal holds a text area: forms must not nest)
an error replaces the hint, is announced (role alert), and is red
...only the fields that are wrong are marked invalid
a form can keep its button OFF (greyed) and says in words what is still needed
...when the button is on, there is no hint
the add form is unchanged: its button is on when not busy
a busy form cannot be sent again: the button is disabled
all typed text is escaped (a script in a field is text, not markup)
a number clash names the line that has it, in the table's words, and says a number belongs to one place
...asks the owner's question: edit an existing line, or a mistake?
...offers to EDIT that very line, and to correct the entry
...a number clash has NO 'add it anyway' button
...it is announced (role alert)
a same-place clash says the place is saved and lists ALL its numbers (40926 / 42043)
...offers 'another number of this place' (only because it can be true), and an edit button for each saved line
a similar-place clash says it reads almost like the saved line (an empty location left out), and offers 'a different place'
conflictText for a number on two lines names both
a line listed twice in two clashes gets ONE edit button
the buttons of a busy question are disabled
saved text is escaped in a clash message
the list shows Department, Location, PAX and a button per line that says which line it is for
an empty location is shown as Office
no lines: a plain sentence
a long list is cut with a word about narrowing it
the history is a TABLE with these columns: When, What, Department, Location, PAX, Done by
an added line: Added, then its department, location and number in their own cells
a changed line shows the NEW line and says what it was
a deleted line shows the line that went; an empty location is shown as Office
an authorisation has no line: three dashes, and the executive is named under the action
who did it: the name, the TICKET NUMBER, and the DESIGNATION (with the role)
without a post in the directory, only the role is shown (no empty dot)
history text is escaped
an empty history says so
the HOD sees all five tabs, with the role named
an authorised executive sees NO 'Authorised people' tab, and is named as such
'add' opens the add form first (three inputs)
the number the HOD typed in the search bar is already in the form, and the department he named is shown as the listed one: 'add pax 42555 for Garage'
'modify' opens on the search for a saved line, with his words in it
'delete' opens on the same search
'delegate' opens the authorised-people tab for the HOD
a delegate who somehow gets the 'delegate' op still gets no people tab content (the server refuses anyway)
the tabs are a real tab list with the chosen one marked
all panel text is escaped (a prefill with a tag is text)
the Add form starts with the button OFF, and the reason under it: choose the department
with a department and a valid number already in the fields (from the sentence typed in the search bar) the button is ON and there is no hint
only a number: still OFF, 'Choose the department from the list.'
only a department: still OFF, 'Type the PAX number.'
the location is NOT required: a department and a number are enough (the form above has no location)
the Change form keeps its own rule (it is not drawn until a line is chosen, so the Add rule cannot leak into it)
the header reads: PAX directory editor, then the person's NAME, then 'Authorised executive' (in this order)
...the three sit in ONE row with ONE gap between them (a single gap class on the row, and no margin or padding classes on the three that would make the gaps unequal)
the HOD's header names him before 'HOD of C&IT'
until the name has arrived: the title and the role only, no empty gap element
the name is escaped
the panel uses this header
the frame is the teal one, clips its glows with overflow-clip (overflow-hidden would stop the action bar from sticking) and keeps its data mark
the three-node rail follows what is typed: nothing typed = the department is CURRENT, the others wait
...a department typed: node 1 done, the PAX number is now the current one (the location is optional and never blocks)
...a valid number too: nodes 1 and 3 done, the optional location stays open; with a location all three are done
...a number that is not valid (52555, four digits) is NOT counted as done: the look asks the same validation as the server
the card says 'Complete' only when the entry is right, 'In progress' otherwise
a right field gets a teal tick inside its box, a wrong one a red alert
the telephone-line plate shows what is typed, and an empty location as Office (the table's own word)
the plate says 'New line' when adding and 'Editing' when a saved line is changed; an empty plate has placeholders
the question asked when an entry clashes sits ABOVE the action bar (the form takes it as its content), and is not there when there is none
the action bar is sticky, holds the button, the cancel button of a change, and the reason in words with an icon
the tabs are UNDERLINE tabs: the chosen one has the teal bar, the others none; a delegate has four, the HOD five
a list's button is rose when it deletes (the DANGER class) and teal otherwise
the number of a line is a teal chip in the lists and in the history; an empty one in the history stays a plain dash
the history marks each kind of action with a coloured dot, once (the word is not repeated)
the delete confirmation: an alert dialog with its name and mark, the line that goes with its number struck through, an empty location as Office
the withdrawal confirmation carries its own mark (data-pax-revoke), not the delete one
a person in the lists has an avatar with the initials, the name, and the line under it; the 'Changing' banner names the saved line
the look escapes everything it draws (a tag in a name, a department or a saved line is text)
the look file makes NO request and keeps NO state (it draws what it is given)
the look file adds no rule of its own: it asks the same validateEntry, and has no pattern for a PAX number
the panel no longer draws anything of its own with the old blue look (no old class constants)
the panel still re-exports what it always exported
no <form> tag in the code of either file (the search modal holds a text area)
the name that came with the answer that opened the editor is in the header on the FIRST paint (the server-side render, where no request can have been answered yet)
...in the right place: after the title, before the role label
with no name in the answer and no session the header has no name yet (it is asked for), and nothing is thrown without a session provider
with no name in the answer the LOGIN COOKIE's session name is used at once (no request)
the name from the answer (the people directory's, the one the history records) wins over the session's
a blank name in the answer falls back to the session's; a blank session name is no name
a name is trimmed and escaped (a tag in it is text)
the editor asks the server for the name ONLY when neither the answer nor the session has it
the stale card is an alert that says somebody else changed the line, and that nothing of the person's was saved
...it says WHO and WHEN (in India time), and lists what they changed as 'it was' and 'it is now'
...and offers the two ways on, each with its own mark
without a recorded change the card still says it was changed, without a name; with nothing visibly different it says the line was saved again in the same words
both buttons are disabled while a request is on its way; everything drawn is escaped
a notice can be AMBER (something to look at): its own tone, announced politely
theirEntryChanges: nothing differs, nothing listed; what the other person changed is listed with the old and the new (an empty location reads Office)
rebaseEntry: the person changed the NUMBER, the other the DEPARTMENT: both are in the result, and nothing the person did not touch is put back
rebaseEntry: a field BOTH changed to different values keeps the person's value and is an overlap; both changing it to the same value is not; changing nothing gives exactly their version
every field has its word for the message that names an overlap
the panel sends the VERSION the person saw with every change and every delete, and handles the 'stale' answer of each
the save button waits (and says why) while the card is shown; the two ways on are the three-way merge and the replacement; choosing another line or cancelling clears the card

the 'still mounted' flag is switched ON again at every mount (React's StrictMode, used by npm run dev, mounts, unmounts and mounts again: without this every answer is thrown away and the button stays greyed)
a request that is not answered ends: the call is aborted after a time limit and the timer is cleared
a missing-table reply (503) shows the server's own sentence on screen, not a generic one
the line about to go shows its number normally, and with hideNumber shows only dots (the number appears nowhere)
the PAX delete card: the title is the place without the number, the number is hidden on the card, and the typed box is the shared TypedConfirm
the button waits for the right number, and the number typed goes to the server
what was typed belongs to one line as it stood: another line, or the same line changed by somebody, starts with an empty box (and 'No' and choosing a line clear it)
a refusal for a wrong number is shown as an error with the server's sentence
the PAX tab and the list button are called MODIFY too (the two tools read alike)
with a list the department is a dropdown button (the listed spelling shown), and there is NO text box for it
while the list is on its way the dropdown says so, and is still not a text box
an empty list says there is nothing to choose from
without a list (the old callers) the department stays a text box

the panel asks the server for the departments once, hands them to both forms, empties a department that came with the request unless it is listed, and keeps the button off for a department that is not listed

the server holds the rule on add AND on change (not only the form), from the plant's register of departments: a name outside the list is refused (a line's own department may stay as it is when only its number changes) as invalid with the department's message, and the listed spelling is what is saved
the change form keeps a line's own department even when it is not in the plant's list (shown in the box, allowed to stay)
the departments are asked from the server with their own request, answered only to a person who may use the editor (after the authority check)
